title: Office network checklist for small businesses
description: A short checklist to keep a small office network in Dubai fast, tidy and secure.
body: Small offices often grow one cable and one device at a time until nobody knows what connects to what. Use this checklist.
Labelled cables and patch panels turn a two-hour fault hunt into a five-minute fix.
Visitors should not be on the same network as your computers, printers and CCTV.
Routers, recorders and printers often ship with default passwords. Change them.
Network equipment in a hot cupboard fails sooner. Make sure there is airflow.
Want a tidy-up of your office network? Message us on WhatsApp.
